## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture edge by refining exit parameters and contract selection to better exploit winner days while minimizing losses on loser days. The edge exists because default parameters may prematurely exit winners or inadequately protect against loser day adverse moves, particularly in HTF-gated directional setups where volume confirmation improves signal quality.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** HTF-gated directional scoring (288-combo sweep parameter space) — requires volume ratio ≥ vol_ratio_threshold (1.2) to confirm institutional participation.  
**Exit:**  
- Take profit at 75% of premium (tp_premium_pct=0.75)  
- Stop loss at 35% of premium (stop_premium_pct=-0.35)  
- Time stop: 12 minutes  
- Chandelier profit-lock arms at 60% of premium (chandelier_arm_pct=0.6) with standard trailing (not swept)  
**Contract selection:** strike_offset=2 (ITM-2 puts for bearish bias per J's edge)  
**Filter:** vol_ratio_threshold=1.2 acts as a quality gate to avoid low-conviction entries.
